input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves Admin, Developer roles. It exposes interfaces for managing behavior. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include task management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to interact with behavior functionality, so that I can accomplish my behavior-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Developer, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Candidate, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
As a Admin, I want to export data in a standard format, so that I can use it in external tools.
